B's thinner rim and calmer lens highlight look closer to the real brass items, while A's thick, glassy bubble lens reads a little more plastic.
Barely different; B's lens is a bit flatter and more transparent, closer to the real lamp glass, while A's carries a heavier dome highlight.
Near-identical pair; B's rim is a touch less chunky and less polished, which fits the real cards slightly better.
Essentially the same drawing; B's lens shows the background through it more clearly, like the real lamp chimney, while A's is more mirror-glossy.
